release_notes: Reolink's compact NVR/hub accessory (used with Reolink battery/WiFi cameras for local storage + AI features without a cloud subscription), not a camera. The camera schema is a poor fit: resolution/lens/night_vision/field_of_view describe the hub itself, which has no image sensor. 'type': 'box' is used only because the schema has no dedicated hub/NVR enum value. 'connectivity' reflects only the hub's own wired uplink (WAN RJ45); it separately hosts a private Wi-Fi access point for its cameras. No official IP rating is published for this indoor-only device, so ip_rating is left unset.
